title: First Steps
desc: Three wobbly, magnificent, world-changing steps across the living room floor. Then you sat down and clapped for yourself.
story: You'd been cruising along the furniture for weeks, letting go for half a second and then grabbing back on. And then on a perfectly ordinary Tuesday afternoon, you let go, looked at us, and took three steps. You wobbled. You made it. You sat down immediately and started clapping your own hands together. So did we. The whole house was cheering.
